researcher_reply: Comparer d’abord les évolutions par corrélation de rang (Spearman), par groupe et aux trois décalages fixés ; laisser les écarts en mètres en attente d’une preuve d’unité (recommandé).
method: Spearman = Pearson correlation of average ranks; tied values receive their average rank
input: Original-unit daily means on exactly the same observed piste lengths from Stage70; no unit conversion
missing_policy: Use finite paired daily values only and report pair counts; fewer than two pairs or either constant ranked series yields missing rho with explicit status, never zero
inference: Descriptive coefficient only; no iid daily p-value or confidence interval, no unapproved block bootstrap specification
scope: Within-group single-winter trajectory concordance, not absolute-level agreement, source-unit proof, causal effect, independent-day sample or long-term climate profile
